issues.quote: I never look at clocks when I am playing with Casimir.
issues.fact: O2 says only that she did not look at the clock when he went out. It does not say she never looked at a clock during the game.
issues.misreading: A solver could read this as a habit covering the whole game, so she had no reliable sense of time during piquet, including when the temple struck ten. That would weaken her ten o'clock reading, which the sheet does not support.
